description_en: Calls the DescribeSqlInsightStatistic operation to aggregate and collect statistics on SQL Explorer data for a specified instance within a given time window, by dimensions such as SQL template, access source, or database user
description_zh: 调用DescribeSqlInsightStatistic接口，按SQL模板、访问来源或数据库用户等维度，聚合统计指定实例在给定时间窗内的SQL洞察数据
name: DescribeSqlInsightStatistic

parameters.help_en:
The database instance ID.

This operation supports RDS for MySQL, PolarDB for MySQL, PolarDB-X, RDS for PostgreSQL, PolarDB for PostgreSQL, RDS for SQL Server, and Lindorm instances that have SQL Explorer enabled. MongoDB and Redis instances are not supported. Calling this operation for unsupported instances returns an error indicating that the operation is not supported
parameters.help_zh:
数据库实例ID。

支持已开启SQL洞察的RDS MySQL、PolarDB MySQL、PolarDB-X、RDS PostgreSQL、PolarDB PostgreSQL、RDS SQL Server、Lindorm实例；MongoDB与Redis实例不支持本接口，调用会返回不支持该操作的错误
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The node ID of the instance. This parameter narrows the statistical scope to the specified node. Only a single node ID is supported. You cannot specify multiple node IDs separated by commas.

This parameter is required only for instances that consist of multiple nodes, such as PolarDB-X and Lindorm instances. You can ignore this parameter for single-node instances
parameters.help_zh:
实例的节点ID，用于把统计范围收敛到指定节点。只支持传入单个节点ID，不支持英文逗号分隔传入多个。

仅在由多个节点组成的实例（例如PolarDB-X、Lindorm）下需要传入，单节点实例可忽略
parameters.name: node_id

parameters.help_en:
The aggregation or filter dimension for statistics. The value is case-insensitive. If this parameter is not specified, statistics are aggregated by SQL template by default. Valid values:

FullRequestOrigin: Aggregates by access source address.
FullRequestUser: Aggregates by database user.
SQL: Filters by SQL template. You must also specify TemplateId as the SQL template ID.
OriginHost: Filters by access source. You must also specify TemplateId as the source address.
User: Filters by database user. You must also specify TemplateId as the username.

Specifying a value other than the preceding values returns an InvalidParams error
parameters.help_zh:
统计的聚合维度或过滤维度，取值不区分大小写。不传时默认按SQL模板维度聚合。取值：

FullRequestOrigin：按访问来源地址维度聚合。
FullRequestUser：按数据库用户维度聚合。
SQL：按SQL模板过滤，需同时传入TemplateId作为SQL模板ID。
OriginHost：按访问来源过滤，需同时传入TemplateId作为来源地址。
User：按数据库用户过滤，需同时传入TemplateId作为用户名。

传入上述之外的取值返回InvalidParams错误
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en:
The identifier of the statistical object. The meaning varies depending on the value of Type. Valid values:

When Type is set to SQL: the SQL template ID, which corresponds to SqlId in the response.
When Type is set to OriginHost: the access source address.
When Type is set to User: the database username.

This parameter does not take effect when Type is not specified, or is set to FullRequestOrigin or FullRequestUser.

When Type is set to SQL, you can specify multiple template IDs separated by commas. In this case, the Keyword parameter does not take effect
parameters.help_zh:
统计对象的标识，含义随Type变化。取值：

Type为SQL时：传SQL模板ID，即返回结果中的SqlId。
Type为OriginHost时：传访问来源地址。
Type为User时：传数据库用户名。

Type为空、FullRequestOrigin或FullRequestUser时本参数不生效。

Type为SQL时支持英文逗号分隔传入多个模板ID，且此时Keyword不再生效
parameters.name: template_id

parameters.help_en:
The keyword for fuzzy retrieve on SQL template content. Separate multiple keywords with spaces. The system first performs keyword match to find the corresponding SQL templates (up to 1,000 templates), and then performs aggregation statistics based on these templates. If no templates match, an empty list is returned.

This parameter does not take effect when Type is set to SQL and TemplateId is specified
parameters.help_zh:
按SQL模板内容进行模糊检索的关键词，多个关键词以空格分隔。系统先根据关键词匹配出对应的SQL模板（最多1000个），再基于这些模板聚合统计；若无匹配模板则返回空列表。

当Type为SQL且已传入TemplateId时本参数不生效
parameters.name: keyword

parameters.help_en:
The start time of the query. Specify a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds. The system rounds down to the nearest minute.

The value must be within the last 30 days. If the value is earlier than the time when SQL Explorer was enabled for the instance, it is automatically adjusted to the time when SQL Explorer was enabled
parameters.help_zh:
查询起始时间，Unix时间戳，单位毫秒。系统按分钟向下取整。

距今不得超过30天；若早于该实例SQL洞察的开启时间，会被自动收敛到开启时间
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end time of the query. Specify a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds. The system rounds up to the nearest minute.

The span between this value and StartTime must not exceed 7 days. If EndTime is earlier than the time when SQL Explorer was enabled for the instance, an error indicating that the query time is earlier than the available time is returned.

Because data aggregation involves latency, the actual effective value is trimmed to a few minutes before the current time. Data from the most recent minutes may not be available
parameters.help_zh:
查询结束时间，Unix时间戳，单位毫秒。系统按分钟向上取整。

与StartTime的跨度不得超过7天。若EndTime早于该实例SQL洞察的开启时间，会返回查询时间早于可用时间的错误。

由于数据汇聚存在延迟，实际生效值会被裁剪到当前时间前推若干分钟，因此最近几分钟的数据可能查询不到
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The field used for sorting. If this parameter is not specified or an unsupported value is specified, the results are sorted by rt (total response time). Valid values:

Response time: rt, avgRt, maxRt, minRt, rtRate.
Executions: count, countRate, timestamp.
Scan rows: rowsExamined, avgRowsExamined.
Returned rows: rowsReturned, totalRowsReturned, avgRowsReturned, maxRowsReturned, minRowsReturned, maxRowReturned, minRowReturned.
Logical reads: logicalRead, totalLogicalRead, avgLogicalRead, maxLogicalRead, minLogicalRead.
Physical reads: physicalRead, totalPhysicalRead, avgPhysicalRead, maxPhysicalRead, minPhysicalRead.
Logical writes (valid only for SQL Server instances): writes, totalWrites, avgWrites, maxWrites, minWrites.
CPU time (valid only for SQL Server instances): totalCpuTime, avgCpuTime, maxCpuTime, minCpuTime.
PolarDB-X compute node metrics (valid only when Role is set to polarx_cn): scnt, avgScnt, rows, avgRows, frows, avgFrows.
Affected rows (valid only for Lindorm instances): totalAffectRows, avgAffectRows.

timestamp sorts by the data timestamp, which is a millisecond-level UNIX timestamp.

Only the first letter is case-insensitive. The remaining characters must exactly match the preceding values. For example, AvgRt is valid but avgrt is not
parameters.help_zh:
排序字段。不传或传入不支持的取值时按rt（总耗时）排序。取值：

耗时类：rt、avgRt、maxRt、minRt、rtRate。
执行次数类：count、countRate、timestamp。
扫描行数类：rowsExamined、avgRowsExamined。
返回行数类：rowsReturned、totalRowsReturned、avgRowsReturned、maxRowsReturned、minRowsReturned、maxRowReturned、minRowReturned。
逻辑读类：logicalRead、totalLogicalRead、avgLogicalRead、maxLogicalRead、minLogicalRead。
物理读类：physicalRead、totalPhysicalRead、avgPhysicalRead、maxPhysicalRead、minPhysicalRead。
逻辑写类（仅SQL Server实例有效）：writes、totalWrites、avgWrites、maxWrites、minWrites。
CPU耗时类（仅SQL Server实例有效）：totalCpuTime、avgCpuTime、maxCpuTime、minCpuTime。
PolarDB-X计算节点类（仅Role为polarx_cn时有效）：scnt、avgScnt、rows、avgRows、frows、avgFrows。
影响行数类（仅Lindorm实例有效）：totalAffectRows、avgAffectRows。

timestamp表示按数据时间戳排序，该时间戳为毫秒级Unix时间戳。

仅首字母大小写不敏感，其余字符需与上述取值完全一致，例如AvgRt有效而avgrt无效
parameters.name: order_by

parameters.help_en:
The sort direction. Default value: false (descending). Valid values:

true: ascending.
false: descending
parameters.help_zh:
排序方向，默认为false（降序）。取值：

true：升序。
false：降序
parameters.name: asc

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from page 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 分页页码，从1开始。不传时按1处理
parameters.name: page_no

parameters.help_en:
The number of statistical entries per page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 2000.

A value greater than 2000 returns an InvalidParams error instead of being trimmed.

When aggregating by access source or database user (Type is set to FullRequestOrigin or FullRequestUser), a value greater than 100 may be reset to 10 in certain aggregation storage pipelines
parameters.help_zh:
每页返回的统计条目数。不传时按10处理，最大不超过2000。

超过2000会返回参数错误InvalidParams，而不是被裁剪。

按访问来源或数据库用户维度聚合（Type为FullRequestOrigin或FullRequestUser）时，部分汇聚存储链路下超过100会被重置为10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to populate time series trend data for each statistical entry, which corresponds to the Trend field in the response. Default value: true. Valid values:

true: Populates trend data.
false: Does not populate trend data.

Enabling this option triggers additional queries for each time slice per entry, which significantly increases query overhead. If the trend filling capability is not enabled for the instance, this parameter does not take effect
parameters.help_zh:
是否为每条统计结果填充时间序列趋势数据，即返回结果中的Trend字段，默认为true。取值：

true：填充趋势数据。
false：不填充趋势数据。

开启后会针对每条结果额外查询各时间片的数据，查询开销明显增加；若实例未开启趋势填充能力，本参数不生效
parameters.name: do_fill_trend

parameters.help_en:
The SQL type used for filtering. Valid values:

select
insert
update
delete

Values are lowercase. In certain aggregation storage pipelines, you can specify multiple values separated by commas. In other pipelines, only a single value is supported
parameters.help_zh:
按SQL类型过滤。取值：

select
insert
update
delete

取值为小写。部分实例的汇聚存储链路下支持英文逗号分隔传入多个取值，其余链路只支持传入单个取值
parameters.name: sql_type

parameters.help_en:
The database name used for filtering.

In certain aggregation storage pipelines, you can specify multiple database names separated by commas. In other pipelines, only a single database name is supported
parameters.help_zh:
按数据库名过滤。

部分实例的汇聚存储链路下支持英文逗号分隔传入多个，其余链路只支持传入单个数据库名
parameters.name: db_name

parameters.help_en:
The role of the instance node. The value is case-insensitive. If this parameter is not specified, the role is automatically resolved from InstanceId. Valid values:

polarx_cn: PolarDB-X compute node.
polarx_dn: PolarDB-X storage node.

This value affects the scope of returned fields. For example, Scnt, Rows, and Frows are returned only when the value is polarx_cn
parameters.help_zh:
实例节点角色，取值不区分大小写。不传时由InstanceId自动解析。取值：

polarx_cn：PolarDB-X计算节点。
polarx_dn：PolarDB-X存储节点。

该取值会影响返回字段的填充范围，例如Scnt、Rows、Frows仅在polarx_cn下返回
parameters.name: role

parameters.help_en: The idempotency ID for the SQL Explorer data query. This parameter is not required for regular queries
parameters.help_zh: SQL洞察数据查询幂等ID，普通查询无需传入
parameters.name: job_id

fields.help_en: The key of the filter condition. The value is case-insensitive. For valid values, see the description of the Filters parameter
fields.help_zh: 过滤条件的键，不区分大小写。可用取值见Filters参数说明
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The value of the filter condition. If the value is null or an empty string, the filter condition is ignored. Separate multiple values with commas. The specific upper limit depends on the corresponding key
fields.help_zh: 过滤条件的值，为null或空字符串时该条过滤条件被忽略。多个值以英文逗号分隔，具体上限取决于对应的键
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en:
The list of structured filter conditions, specified as Key/Value pairs. The POP format is Filters.N.Key and Filters.N.Value, with a maximum of 100 pairs. Key is case-insensitive. Entries with an empty Value are ignored. Valid values of Key for this operation:

keyWord: the keyword. The value is split by whitespace into multiple words and takes effect together with the Keyword parameter.
hostAddress: the access source address. Separate multiple values with commas. This takes effect together with TemplateId when Type is set to OriginHost.
accountName: the database username. Separate multiple values with commas.
dbName: the database name. Separate multiple values with commas. This takes effect together with the DbName parameter.
sqlType: the SQL type. Separate multiple values with commas. This takes effect together with the SqlType parameter.
sqlId: the SQL template ID. Separate multiple values with commas. This takes effect together with TemplateId when Type is set to SQL.
insRole: the primary/secondary role. Valid values: master and slave. These values are case-sensitive.

Any Key value other than the preceding values is ignored.

This parameter takes effect only in certain aggregation storage pipelines. In other pipelines, this parameter is entirely ignored
parameters.help_zh:
结构化过滤条件列表，以Key/Value键值对形式传入，POP线格式为Filters.N.Key与Filters.N.Value，最多100组。Key不区分大小写，Value为空的条目会被忽略。本接口生效的Key取值：

keyWord：关键词，按空白字符拆分为多个词，与Keyword参数合并生效。
hostAddress：访问来源地址，英文逗号分隔多个，与Type为OriginHost时的TemplateId合并生效。
accountName：数据库用户名，英文逗号分隔多个。
dbName：数据库名，英文逗号分隔多个，与DbName参数合并生效。
sqlType：SQL类型，英文逗号分隔多个，与SqlType参数合并生效。
sqlId：SQL模板ID，英文逗号分隔多个，与Type为SQL时的TemplateId合并生效。
insRole：主备角色，取值master或slave，该取值区分大小写。

传入上述之外的Key会被忽略。

本参数仅在部分实例的汇聚存储链路下生效，其余链路会整体忽略该参数
parameters.name: filters

Data.description_en: The envelope for asynchronous query results. The first call returns ResultId and State. Poll with the exact same request parameters until State is SUCCESS, then retrieve the statistical details from List
Data.description_zh: 异步查询结果信封。首次调用返回ResultId与State，需携带完全相同的请求参数轮询，直到State为SUCCESS后从List中获取统计明细

Data.description_en:
The SQL Explorer statistical query results.

Returned only when State is SUCCESS
Data.description_zh:
SQL洞察统计查询结果。

仅当State为SUCCESS时返回

Extra.description_en:
The extended information.

This field is not returned by this operation
Extra.description_zh:
扩展信息。

本接口不返回该字段

List.description_en: The list of SQL Explorer statistical results. Each element is a statistical entry under an aggregation dimension
List.description_zh: SQL洞察统计结果列表，每个元素为一个聚合维度下的统计条目

AffectRows.description_en:
The number of affected rows for a single SQL statement. For SELECT statements, this indicates the number of scanned rows. For DML statements, this indicates the number of affected rows.

Returned only for Lindorm instances
AffectRows.description_zh:
单条SQL的影响行数。SELECT表示扫描行数，DML表示影响行数。

仅Lindorm实例返回

AggKey.description_en:
The value of the aggregation dimension for this statistical entry, which varies based on the Type request parameter. Valid values:

When aggregated by SQL template: the SQL template ID, which is the same as SqlId.
When Type is set to FullRequestOrigin: the access source address.
When Type is set to FullRequestUser: the database username
AggKey.description_zh:
本次统计的聚合维度取值，随请求参数Type变化。取值：

按SQL模板聚合时：SQL模板ID，与SqlId一致。
Type为FullRequestOrigin时：访问来源地址。
Type为FullRequestUser时：数据库用户名

AvgAffectRows.description_en:
The average number of affected rows.

Returned only for Lindorm instances. The value is null for other database engines
AvgAffectRows.description_zh:
平均影响行数。

仅Lindorm实例返回，其它引擎为null

AvgCpuTime.description_en:
The average CPU time consumed by SQL execution, in microseconds.

This metric is exclusive to SQL Server instances. The value is null for other database engines
AvgCpuTime.description_zh:
SQL执行消耗的平均CPU耗时，单位微秒。

为SQL Server实例专属指标，其它引擎为null

AvgFrows.description_en:
The average number of rows fetched by the PolarDB-X compute node from data nodes.

This metric is exclusive to PolarDB-X compute nodes. The value is null or 0 for other database engines
AvgFrows.description_zh:
PolarDB-X计算节点从数据节点拉取的平均行数。

为PolarDB-X计算节点专属指标，其它引擎为null或0

AvgLockWaitTime.description_en:
The average lock wait time per execution, in milliseconds.

Data is available only when Version is set to 1
AvgLockWaitTime.description_zh:
单次执行的平均锁等待耗时，单位毫秒。

仅在Version为1时有数据

AvgLogicalRead.description_en:
The average number of logical reads per execution.

Data is available only when Version is set to 1
AvgLogicalRead.description_zh:
单次执行的平均逻辑读次数。

仅在Version为1时有数据

AvgPhysicalAsyncRead.description_en:
The average number of physical asynchronous reads per execution.

Data is available only when Version is set to 1
AvgPhysicalAsyncRead.description_zh:
单次执行的平均物理异步读次数。

仅在Version为1时有数据

AvgPhysicalRead.description_en:
The average number of physical reads.

This metric is exclusive to SQL Server instances. The value is null for other database engines
AvgPhysicalRead.description_zh:
平均物理读次数。

为SQL Server实例专属指标，其它引擎为null

AvgPhysicalSyncRead.description_en:
The average number of physical synchronous reads per execution.

Data is available only when Version is set to 1
AvgPhysicalSyncRead.description_zh:
单次执行的平均物理同步读次数。

仅在Version为1时有数据

AvgRows.description_en:
The average number of updated rows and returned rows for the PolarDB-X compute node.

This metric is exclusive to PolarDB-X compute nodes. The value is null or 0 for other database engines
AvgRows.description_zh:
PolarDB-X计算节点的平均更新行数与返回行数。

为PolarDB-X计算节点专属指标，其它引擎为null或0
AvgRows.title_en: polarx cn节点,平均更新/返回行数
AvgRows.title_zh: polarx cn节点,平均更新/返回行数

AvgRowsExamined.description_en: The average number of rows scanned per execution
AvgRowsExamined.description_zh: 单次执行的平均扫描行数

AvgRowsReturned.description_en: The average number of rows returned per execution
AvgRowsReturned.description_zh: 单次执行的平均返回行数

AvgRowsUpdated.description_en: The average number of rows updated per execution
AvgRowsUpdated.description_zh: 单次执行的平均更新行数

AvgRt.description_en: The average execution time per execution, in milliseconds
AvgRt.description_zh: 单次执行的平均耗时，单位毫秒

AvgScanRows.description_en:
The average number of scanned rows.

This field is not returned by this operation. Use AvgRowsExamined for the average number of scanned rows
AvgScanRows.description_zh:
平均扫描行数。

本接口不返回该字段，平均扫描行数请使用AvgRowsExamined
AvgScanRows.title_en: 平均扫描行数，RDS MySQL DescribeSqlLogTemplatesList
AvgScanRows.title_zh: 平均扫描行数，RDS MySQL DescribeSqlLogTemplatesList

AvgScnt.description_en:
The average number of requests sent by the PolarDB-X compute node to data nodes.

This metric is exclusive to PolarDB-X compute nodes. The value is null or 0 for other database engines
AvgScnt.description_zh:
PolarDB-X计算节点下发到数据节点的平均请求数。

为PolarDB-X计算节点专属指标，其它引擎为null或0

AvgWrites.description_en:
The average number of logical writes.

This metric is exclusive to SQL Server instances. The value is null for other database engines
AvgWrites.description_zh:
平均逻辑写次数。

为SQL Server实例专属指标，其它引擎为null

Count.description_en: The total number of executions of the SQL template within the statistical interval
Count.description_zh: 该SQL模板在统计区间内的执行总次数

CountRate.description_en: The ratio of the number of executions of this statistical entry to the total number of executions of all SQL statements on the instance. The value ranges from 0 to 1
CountRate.description_zh: 该条统计的执行次数占实例全部SQL执行次数的比例，取值范围为0到1

CpuTime.description_en:
The total CPU time consumed by SQL execution, in microseconds.

This metric is exclusive to SQL Server instances. The value is null for other database engines
CpuTime.description_zh:
SQL执行消耗的CPU耗时合计，单位微秒。

为SQL Server实例专属指标，其它引擎为null

Database.description_en: The name of the database where the SQL statement is executed
Database.description_zh: 该SQL执行所在的数据库名

ErrorCode.description_en:
The error code returned by SQL execution.

The error code is a detail of a single SQL statement. This operation returns template-level aggregated statistics and does not return this field. Use ErrorCount for error information
ErrorCode.description_zh:
SQL执行返回的错误码。

错误码属于单条SQL明细信息，本接口返回的是模板维度的聚合统计，不返回该字段；报错情况请使用ErrorCount

ErrorCount.description_en: The number of execution errors for the SQL template within the statistical interval
ErrorCount.description_zh: 该SQL模板在统计区间内执行报错的次数

FirstTime.description_en:
The time when the SQL template first appeared.

This field is not returned by this operation
FirstTime.description_zh:
SQL模板首次出现的时间。

本接口不返回该字段

Frows.description_en:
The total number of rows fetched by the PolarDB-X compute node from data nodes.

This metric is exclusive to PolarDB-X compute nodes. The value is null or 0 for other database engines
Frows.description_zh:
PolarDB-X计算节点从数据节点拉取的行数合计。

为PolarDB-X计算节点专属指标，其它引擎为null或0

Hash.description_en:
The hash value of the SQL template, returned together with the SQL template.

This value is generated by the PolarDB-X compute node kernel. The value is empty for non-PolarDB-X compute node instances
Hash.description_zh:
SQL模板哈希值，随SQL模板一并返回。

该值由PolarDB-X计算节点内核输出，非PolarDB-X计算节点实例为空

Ip.description_en:
The endpoint of the instance to which the statistical data belongs.

Whether this field is returned depends on the aggregated storage link of the instance. The value is null for some links
Ip.description_zh:
统计数据所属实例的连接地址。

是否返回取决于实例的汇聚存储链路，部分链路下为null

LockWaitTime.description_en:
The total lock wait time, in milliseconds.

Data is available only when Version is set to 1
LockWaitTime.description_zh:
锁等待耗时合计，单位毫秒。

仅在Version为1时有数据

LogicalRead.description_en:
The total number of logical reads.

Data is available only when Version is set to 1
LogicalRead.description_zh:
逻辑读次数合计。

仅在Version为1时有数据

MaxCpuTime.description_en:
The maximum CPU time in a single execution, in microseconds.

This metric is exclusive to SQL Server instances. The value is null for other database engines
MaxCpuTime.description_zh:
单次执行中CPU耗时的最大值，单位微秒。

为SQL Server实例专属指标，其它引擎为null

MaxLogicalRead.description_en:
The maximum number of logical reads in a single execution.

Data is available only when Version is set to 1
MaxLogicalRead.description_zh:
单次执行中逻辑读次数的最大值。

仅在Version为1时有数据

MaxPhysicalRead.description_en:
The maximum number of physical reads in a single execution.

This metric is exclusive to SQL Server instances. The value is null for other database engines
MaxPhysicalRead.description_zh:
单次执行中物理读次数的最大值。

为SQL Server实例专属指标，其它引擎为null

MaxRowsExamined.description_en:
The maximum number of rows scanned in a single execution.

This field is not returned by this operation. Use RowsExamined and AvgRowsExamined for scanned row counts
MaxRowsExamined.description_zh:
单次执行中扫描行数的最大值。

本接口不返回该字段，扫描行数请使用RowsExamined与AvgRowsExamined

MaxRowsReturned.description_en: The maximum number of rows returned in a single execution
MaxRowsReturned.description_zh: 单次执行中返回行数的最大值

MaxRt.description_en: The maximum execution time in a single execution, in milliseconds
MaxRt.description_zh: 单次执行的最大耗时，单位毫秒

MaxWrites.description_en:
The maximum number of logical writes in a single execution.

This metric is exclusive to SQL Server instances. The value is null for other database engines
MaxWrites.description_zh:
单次执行中逻辑写次数的最大值。

为SQL Server实例专属指标，其它引擎为null

MinCpuTime.description_en:
The minimum CPU time in a single execution, in microseconds.

This metric is exclusive to SQL Server instances. The value is null for other database engines
MinCpuTime.description_zh:
单次执行中CPU耗时的最小值，单位微秒。

为SQL Server实例专属指标，其它引擎为null

MinLogicalRead.description_en:
The minimum number of logical reads in a single execution.

Data is available only when Version is set to 1
MinLogicalRead.description_zh:
单次执行中逻辑读次数的最小值。

仅在Version为1时有数据

MinPhysicalRead.description_en:
The minimum number of physical reads in a single execution.

This metric is exclusive to SQL Server instances. The value is null for other database engines
MinPhysicalRead.description_zh:
单次执行中物理读次数的最小值。

为SQL Server实例专属指标，其它引擎为null

MinRowsReturned.description_en: The minimum number of rows returned in a single execution
MinRowsReturned.description_zh: 单次执行中返回行数的最小值

MinRt.description_en: The minimum execution time in a single execution, in milliseconds
MinRt.description_zh: 单次执行的最小耗时，单位毫秒

MinWrites.description_en:
The minimum number of logical writes in a single execution.

This metric is exclusive to SQL Server instances. The value is null for other database engines
MinWrites.description_zh:
单次执行中逻辑写次数的最小值。

为SQL Server实例专属指标，其它引擎为null

OriginAlias.description_en:
The display alias configured for the access source address.

Returned only when aggregated by access source (when Type is set to FullRequestOrigin). The value is null in other scenarios
OriginAlias.description_zh:
为访问来源地址配置的展示别名。

仅在按访问来源聚合（Type为FullRequestOrigin）时返回，其它场景为null

OriginHost.description_en:
The source address of the client that initiated the SQL statement.

When Type is set to FullRequestOrigin, this field serves as the aggregation dimension for the statistical entry
OriginHost.description_zh:
发起该SQL的客户端来源地址。

当Type为FullRequestOrigin时，该字段即为这条统计的聚合维度

Params.description_en:
The parameter content of the SQL sample.

This operation returns template-level aggregated statistics and does not return this field
Params.description_zh:
SQL样例的参数内容。

本接口返回的是模板维度的聚合统计，不返回该字段
Params.title_en: polarx cn节点样例数据 参数是单独的字段
Params.title_zh: polarx cn节点样例数据 参数是单独的字段

PhysicalAsyncRead.description_en:
The total number of physical asynchronous reads.

Data is available only when Version is set to 1
PhysicalAsyncRead.description_zh:
物理异步读次数合计。

仅在Version为1时有数据

PhysicalRead.description_en:
The total number of physical reads.

This metric is exclusive to SQL Server instances. The value is null for other database engines
PhysicalRead.description_zh:
物理读次数合计。

为SQL Server实例专属指标，其它引擎为null

PhysicalSyncRead.description_en:
The total number of physical synchronous reads.

Data is available only when Version is set to 1
PhysicalSyncRead.description_zh:
物理同步读次数合计。

仅在Version为1时有数据

Port.description_en:
The port of the instance to which the statistical data belongs.

Whether this field is returned depends on the aggregated storage link of the instance. The value is null for some links
Port.description_zh:
统计数据所属实例的连接端口。

是否返回取决于实例的汇聚存储链路，部分链路下为null

Psql.description_en: The parameterized SQL template text, which is the statement with constants in the SQL replaced by placeholders
Psql.description_zh: 参数化后的SQL模板文本，即把SQL中的常量替换为占位符后的语句

Rows.description_en:
The total number of updated rows and returned rows for the PolarDB-X compute node.

This metric is exclusive to PolarDB-X compute nodes. The value is null or 0 for other engines
Rows.description_zh:
PolarDB-X计算节点的更新行数与返回行数合计。

为PolarDB-X计算节点专属指标，其它引擎为null或0
Rows.title_en: polarx cn节点,总更新/返回行数
Rows.title_zh: polarx cn节点,总更新/返回行数

RowsExamined.description_en: The total number of rows examined by the SQL template within the statistical interval
RowsExamined.description_zh: 该SQL模板在统计区间内的扫描行数合计

RowsReturned.description_en: The total number of rows returned by the SQL template within the statistical interval
RowsReturned.description_zh: 该SQL模板在统计区间内的返回行数合计

Rt.description_en:
The total execution duration of the SQL template within the statistical interval. Unit: milliseconds.

For PolarDB-X compute nodes (where Role is polarx_cn) with kernel versions earlier than 5.4.13, this value is converted from microseconds to milliseconds
Rt.description_zh:
该SQL模板在统计区间内的总耗时，单位毫秒。

PolarDB-X计算节点（Role为polarx_cn）在内核版本早于5.4.13时，该值由微秒换算为毫秒

RtGreaterThanOneSecondCount.description_en:
The number of times the execution duration exceeds 1 second.

Whether this field is returned depends on the aggregation storage link of the instance. The value is null for certain links
RtGreaterThanOneSecondCount.description_zh:
执行耗时超过1秒的次数。

是否返回取决于实例的汇聚存储链路，部分链路下为null

RtRate.description_en: The ratio of the total execution duration of this entry to the total execution duration of all SQL statements on the instance. Valid values: 0 to 1
RtRate.description_zh: 该条统计的总耗时占实例全部SQL总耗时的比例，取值范围为0到1

SampleType.description_en:
The type identifier of the sample data.

This operation returns aggregated statistics and does not return this field
SampleType.description_zh:
样本数据的类型标识。

本接口返回的是聚合统计，不返回该字段

ScanRows.description_en:
The number of rows scanned by a single SQL statement.

This operation returns template-level aggregated statistics and does not return this field. Use the aggregated metrics RowsExamined and AvgRowsExamined instead
ScanRows.description_zh:
单条SQL的扫描行数。

本接口返回的是模板维度的聚合统计，不返回该字段，请使用聚合指标RowsExamined与AvgRowsExamined
ScanRows.title_en: 扫描行数, RDS MySQL DescribeTemplateSqlDetail
ScanRows.title_zh: 扫描行数, RDS MySQL DescribeTemplateSqlDetail

Scnt.description_en:
The total number of requests sent from the PolarDB-X compute node to data nodes.

This metric is exclusive to PolarDB-X compute nodes. The value is null or 0 for other engines
Scnt.description_zh:
PolarDB-X计算节点下发到数据节点的请求总数。

为PolarDB-X计算节点专属指标，其它引擎为null或0

Sql.description_en:
The original SQL text.

The statistical results return the SQL template (Psql) and do not return this field
Sql.description_zh:
原始SQL文本。

统计结果返回的是SQL模板（Psql），不返回该字段

SqlId.description_en: The SQL template ID that uniquely identifies a type of parameterized SQL statement. Multiple executions under the same template are aggregated into a single statistical entry. You can use this ID to correlate the same type of SQL across multi-dimensional queries
SqlId.description_zh: SQL模板ID，唯一标识一类参数化后的SQL语句。同一模板下的多次执行会被聚合为一条统计，可用该ID在多维度查询间关联同一类SQL

SqlNew.description_en:
The SQL text with parameter values uniformly processed, used in sample data scenarios.

This operation does not return this field
SqlNew.description_zh:
对参数值做统一处理后的SQL文本，用于样本数据场景。

本接口不返回该字段
SqlNew.title_en: 样本数据里面通过统一值加密的SQL
SqlNew.title_zh: 样本数据里面通过统一值加密的SQL

SqlTextFeature.description_en:
The SQL text feature value, used in SQL analysis scenarios.

This operation does not return this field
SqlTextFeature.description_zh:
SQL文本特征值，用于SQL分析场景。

本接口不返回该字段

SqlType.description_en:
The SQL type. Valid values:

select
insert
update
delete
other
SqlType.description_zh:
SQL类型。取值：

select
insert
update
delete
other

SumRowsUpdated.description_en: The total number of rows updated by the SQL template within the statistical interval
SumRowsUpdated.description_zh: 该SQL模板在统计区间内的更新行数合计

Tables.description_en: The list of table names involved in the SQL statement

items.description_en: The table name involved in the SQL statement

ThreadId.description_en:
The database thread ID that executed the SQL statement.

The thread ID is a detail of a single SQL statement. This operation returns template-level aggregated statistics and does not return this field
ThreadId.description_zh:
执行该SQL的数据库线程ID。

线程ID属于单条SQL明细信息，本接口返回的是模板维度的聚合统计，不返回该字段

TimeRate.description_en:
The execution duration ratio.

This operation returns the execution duration ratio through RtRate and does not return this field
TimeRate.description_zh:
耗时占比。

本接口通过RtRate返回耗时占比，不返回该字段

Timestamp.description_en:
The data timestamp. This value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds.

The statistical results are aggregated at the SQL template level and do not return this field
Timestamp.description_zh:
数据时间戳，Unix时间戳，单位毫秒。

统计结果按SQL模板维度汇总，不返回该字段

TotalAffectRows.description_en:
The total number of affected rows.

This field is returned only for Lindorm instances. The value is null for other engines
TotalAffectRows.description_zh:
影响行数合计。

仅Lindorm实例返回，其它引擎为null

TotalRt.description_en:
The total SQL execution duration.

This operation does not return this field. Use Rt for the total execution duration
TotalRt.description_zh:
SQL执行总耗时。

本接口不返回该字段，总耗时请使用Rt

TotalScanRows.description_en:
The total number of rows scanned.

This operation does not return this field. Use RowsExamined for the total number of rows scanned
TotalScanRows.description_zh:
扫描行数合计。

本接口不返回该字段，扫描行数合计请使用RowsExamined

Trend.description_en:
The execution count trend sequence of the SQL template, divided into time slices within the query time window.

This field is returned only when the request parameter DoFillTrend is set to true and the trend padding capability is enabled for the instance. The time slice interval is automatically determined by the query span. Time slices with no data may be padded with zeros
Trend.description_zh:
该SQL模板在查询时间窗内按时间片划分的执行次数趋势序列。

仅当请求参数DoFillTrend为true且实例已开启趋势填充能力时返回；时间片间隔由查询跨度自动决定，无数据的时间片可能补零

Timestamp.description_en: The timestamp of the trend data point. This value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds
Timestamp.description_zh: 趋势点的时间戳，Unix时间戳，单位毫秒

Value.description_en: The number of SQL executions within the time slice
Value.description_zh: 该时间片内的SQL执行次数

UpdateRows.description_en:
The number of rows updated by a single SQL statement.

This operation returns template-level aggregated statistics and does not return this field. Use the aggregated metrics SumRowsUpdated and AvgRowsUpdated instead
UpdateRows.description_zh:
单条SQL的更新行数。

本接口返回的是模板维度的聚合统计，不返回该字段，请使用聚合指标SumRowsUpdated与AvgRowsUpdated
UpdateRows.title_en: 更新行数, RDS MySQL DescribeTemplateSqlDetail
UpdateRows.title_zh: 更新行数, RDS MySQL DescribeTemplateSqlDetail

User.description_en:
The database username that executed the SQL statement.

When Type is set to FullRequestUser, this field serves as the aggregation dimension for the statistical entry
User.description_zh:
执行该SQL的数据库用户名。

当Type为FullRequestUser时，该字段即为这条统计的聚合维度

Version.description_en:
The SQL Explorer data collection link version. The value 1 is returned when the instance collects logical read or lock wait data. Otherwise, the value 0 is returned. Valid values:

0: V0 basic collection link.
1: V1 collection link, which additionally collects four metrics (LockWaitTime, LogicalRead, PhysicalSyncRead, and PhysicalAsyncRead) on top of V0.

When the value is 0, the extended metrics contain no data
Version.description_zh:
SQL洞察数据采集链路版本。实例采集到逻辑读或锁等待数据时返回1，否则返回0。取值：

0：V0基础采集链路。
1：V1采集链路，在V0基础上额外采集LockWaitTime、LogicalRead、PhysicalSyncRead、PhysicalAsyncRead四类指标。

返回0时上述扩展指标无数据

VpcId.description_en:
The VPC ID of the instance to which the statistical data belongs.

Whether this field is returned depends on the aggregation storage link of the instance. The value is null for certain links
VpcId.description_zh:
统计数据所属实例的专有网络VPC ID。

是否返回取决于实例的汇聚存储链路，部分链路下为null

Writes.description_en:
The total number of logical writes.

This metric is exclusive to SQL Server instances. The value is null for other engines
Writes.description_zh:
逻辑写次数合计。

为SQL Server实例专属指标，其它引擎为null

PageNo.description_en: The current page number, corresponding to the request parameter PageNo
PageNo.description_zh: 当前页码，与请求参数PageNo对应

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page, corresponding to the request parameter PageSize
PageSize.description_zh: 每页返回的条数，与请求参数PageSize对应

Total.description_en: The total number of statistical entries that match the query conditions. You can use this value for pagination calculation
Total.description_zh: 满足查询条件的统计条目总数，可用于分页计算

ErrorCode.description_en:
The error code of the asynchronous query failure.

This field is returned only when the query fails
ErrorCode.description_zh:
异步查询失败的错误码。

仅在查询失败时返回

IsFinish.description_en:
Indicates whether the asynchronous query has completed. Valid values:

true: State is SUCCESS or FAIL.
false: State is RUNNING
IsFinish.description_zh:
异步查询是否已结束。取值：

true：State为SUCCESS或FAIL。
false：State为RUNNING

Message.description_en:
The error description of the asynchronous query failure.

This field is returned only when the query fails
Message.description_zh:
异步查询失败的错误描述。

仅在查询失败时返回
Message.example: startTime must be in 30 days and the interval must be within 7 day

RequestKey.description_en:
The hash identifier of the request parameters.

This operation does not return this field. Use ResultId to identify the asynchronous query
RequestKey.description_zh:
请求参数的哈希标识。

本接口不返回该字段，请使用ResultId标识异步查询

ResultId.description_en:
The asynchronous query result ID, in the format of an async_ prefix followed by a hash value computed from all business parameters of the request.

Repeated calls with the same parameters return the same query result. Therefore, when polling, you must use exactly the same request parameters as the initial call. Any change in parameters generates a different ResultId and triggers a new query
ResultId.description_zh:
异步查询结果ID，形如async_前缀加一串哈希值，由本次请求的全部业务参数计算得出。

相同参数重复调用会命中同一份查询结果，因此轮询时必须携带与首次调用完全相同的请求参数；任一参数变化都会生成不同的ResultId并触发一次全新的查询

State.description_en:
The current status of the asynchronous query. Valid values:

RUNNING: The query is in progress. Continue polling.
SUCCESS: The query succeeded. The Data field contains data only in this state.
FAIL: The query failed.

When the query fails, the operation directly returns an error code and error message instead of a normal response body with State set to FAIL
State.description_zh:
异步查询的当前状态。取值：

RUNNING：执行中，需继续轮询。
SUCCESS：执行成功，此时Data才有值。
FAIL：执行失败。

查询失败时接口会直接返回错误码与错误信息，而非State为FAIL的正常响应体
State.title_en: 当前状态 (RUNNING: 正在运行, SUCCESS: 成功, FAIL: 失败)
State.title_zh: 当前状态 (RUNNING: 正在运行, SUCCESS: 成功, FAIL: 失败)

Timestamp.description_en:
The time when the asynchronous query was submitted. This value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds.

When the query fails, this value indicates the time when the failure occurred
Timestamp.description_zh:
提交本次异步查询的时间，Unix时间戳，单位毫秒。

查询失败时该值为失败发生的时间

Message.description_en: The response message. An error description is returned if the request fails
Message.description_zh: 响应信息。请求失败时返回错误描述

RequestId.description_en: The unique ID of the request, which can be used for troubleshooting
RequestId.description_zh: 本次请求的唯一标识，可用于问题排查

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true: The request was successful.
false: The request failed. Check the Code and Message fields to determine the cause
Success.description_zh:
本次请求是否成功。取值：

true：成功。
false：失败，此时结合Code与Message判断原因
